Class AbstractMongoQuery

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.query.AbstractMongoQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
RepositoryQuery
Direct Known Subclasses:
PartTreeMongoQuery, StringBasedAggregation, StringBasedMongoQuery, VectorSearchAggregation
public abstract class AbstractMongoQuery extends Object implements RepositoryQuery
Mongo 中 RepositoryQuery 实现类的基类。
